$schema: Manifest schema for ECHO project wiki ingestion. The lead agent generates .manifest.json following this structure.

<folder>/<filename>.md.title: Display name for index.md
<folder>/<filename>.md.summary: One-line description for index.md (written by lead agent, never parsed from page content)
<folder>/<filename>.md.raw: path/to/source/file.md (source pages only, omit for entities/concepts/analyses)

_rules.filenames: kebab-case, globally unique across all folders. Prefix with src- if a source page would collide with a concept/entity.
_rules.link_field: Filename only. No folder prefix, no .md extension. Agents copy this into [[link]] verbatim.
_rules.summary_field: Max 120 chars. Written during manifest generation so consolidation never parses page content.
_rules.aliases_field: Must include at least the Title Case version of the filename. Obsidian uses these to resolve [[wikilinks]].
_rules.topic_field: Must match the taxonomy below. Reuse existing topics before creating new ones.
_rules.raw_field: Relative path from project root. Only on source pages. Entities/concepts/analyses omit this.

_folders.sources/: Strategic decisions, spec docs, captured reasoning
_folders.entities/: Components, surfaces, target cohorts, integrated tools

_consolidation.index.md: Built from manifest: group entries by folder, then by topic. Each line: - [[link|title]] — summary
_consolidation.log.md: Append one entry per operation with timestamp, operation type, and page counts.
